description: My Property Box are pleased to market this Student Property available Summer. A spacious house situated within West Jesmond, within close proximity to wide array of local amenities including shops, restaurants and bars. The accommodation briefly comprises, to the ground floor; entrance porch, entrance hall, lounge, one bedroom and breakfasting kitchen. To the first floor there are three bedrooms, shower room/wc, bathroom/wc and a separate wc. There are a further two bedrooms, one of which has the benefit of an en-suite to the second floor. The property is warmed by gas central heating via a combination boiler. Externally there is small garden to the front and a yard to the rear with off road parking for small car. Call MPB today to arrange a viewing.
